# Generated by the ZIN content builder (economy spec). Do not edit by hand.
# The Golden Court's treasury (zin_aenor_gold, 0 to 2000). Every change goes through zin_economy_add_gold. Callers set the temporary
# variable zin_arg_value first (a negative value spends); the effect does nothing in a realm without the treasury.

zin_economy_add_gold = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_economy_has_treasury }
		add_to_variable = { zin_aenor_gold = zin_arg_value }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_aenor_gold < 0 } }
			set_variable = { zin_aenor_gold = 0 }
			zin_economy_apply_crown_debts = yes
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_aenor_gold min = 0 max = 2000 }
	}
}

# Crown Debts: a timed idea, restarted when it is already running.
zin_economy_apply_crown_debts = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = zin_econ_crown_debts }
		remove_ideas = zin_econ_crown_debts
	}
	add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_econ_crown_debts days = 180 }
}

# Monthly income and spending (spec: the income and drain tables). Runs on the first day of each month in the treasury realm.
zin_economy_monthly_gold = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_econ_income = 20 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_resources_in_country = { resource = chromium amount > 19 extracted = yes } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_econ_income = 20 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_resources_in_country = { resource = chromium amount > 9 extracted = yes } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_econ_income = 10 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_resources_in_country = { resource = chromium amount > 4 extracted = yes } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_econ_income = 5 }
	}
	set_variable = { zin_econ_tribute_count = 0 }
	every_subject_country = {
		limit = {
			has_autonomy_state = zin_autonomy_chartered_dominion
			check_variable = { zin_concord_loyalty > 39 }
		}
		PREV = { add_to_variable = { zin_econ_tribute_count = 1 } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_econ_tribute = zin_econ_tribute_count }
	add_to_temp_variable = { zin_econ_income = zin_econ_tribute }
	if = {
		limit = {
			num_of_civilian_factories > 29
			NOT = { has_war_with_major = yes }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_econ_income = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_elves_wall_roads_closed }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_econ_income = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_elves_cold_roads }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_econ_income = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_wall_accord }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_econ_income = 3 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_econ_upkeep = zin_court_corruption }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_golden_king_dead }
		multiply_temp_variable = { zin_econ_upkeep = 0.15 }
	}
	else = {
		multiply_temp_variable = { zin_econ_upkeep = 0.3 }
	}
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_econ_income = zin_econ_upkeep }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_econ_income }
	zin_economy_add_gold = yes
}
